name: Yamaha Vino 50
engine: 49 cc single, two-stroke on early years and four-stroke from 2006, carb, CVT
intro: Yamaha's retro 50. Early ones are two-strokes with oil injection; later ones are four-strokes.

B: Check whether yours is the two-stroke or the four-stroke before you buy oil or parts. The two-stroke has an oil tank under the seat.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
